stem: How does the conversation between Owner and Dog lead to the play's resolution?

options.label: F
options.text: It shows Owner how protective Dog has been in the past.

options.label: G
options.text: It allows Dog to be honest with Owner.

options.label: H
options.text: It lets Owner explain to Dog how busy he is.

options.label: J
options.text: It shows that Dog does not understand how to treat books.
